test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the letter-cluster that is different.
solution:
Table show alphabet serial number –

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/286550159bb1b1af83b0ffca14b226c7cea8abbacc574e15aefc51c80aadcc47.png] 

The pattern followed is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7656d7a8f128da9240c621623283212c3116e80e7eda86352cdde7a2c26fe6a.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e1e2fdf10425fe2b4cee7e29c7c87937f431e0796fafd64e3d116d083e72a8d.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c85d59abb7f245072f60eed17c913e592efe592e8e522c8695e92c7876e6030.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70949d891da1142add9f1590785f2b2158ed288ceb340f1abd20fe79709b5448.png] 

All follow the same pattern, except 'CGILN’.

Hence, “**CGILN**” is the odd one.
